entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. It's not working out and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF77819. Look, don't give me a runaround, I just want to send it back.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order pulled up. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it, I just completely changed my mind. It was a stupid impulse buy and I just don't use it. It's been sitting in its box for weeks. I want a refund.
Okay, I understand. So it's not a defect, you've just decided it's not the right product for you. Let me quickly review the return eligibility for your order.
You'd better. I know your policy says 90 days. I've had this thing for about a month. If you try to deny this I'm going to file a chargeback and I want your manager's name. This is ridiculous.

I understand your frustration, Sam. Let me see... I show your VeloBand was delivered on December 21st, which was 33 days ago. You are correct, our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery.
So? Are you processing the return or are you going to waste more of my time?

Yes, of course. You are well within the timeframe, so I can go ahead and authorize this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label and I'll send it to the email address we have on file. Is that address still correct?
Wait, really? That's it? Yes, the email is correct. So it's a full refund?

That's correct. A full refund to your original payment method. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will be processed within 5 to 7 business days.
Oh. Okay. Well, fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
